newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong in rights and bonus issues.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong in rights and bonus issues.

text.p: Ssangyong Paper Co Ltd, an affiliate of South Korea's Ssangyong Group, said on Wednesday that it planned to offer a 41-for-100 rights issue in June and a 10-for-100 bonus issue in July.
The issues will raise the company's paid-in capital to 39.7 billion won from 24.1 billion at present.

A Ssangyong statement said the company would issue new 2.4 million common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered for its employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders as of May 27 for rights.
The issue price will be set at a 20 percent discount on the base price, which will be annouced later.
Subscription is scheduled for June 2 and 3, with payment due by July 2.
The company plans to issue new 712,927 common shares for the bonus issue on July 3.
